atoms.a: For every 2 pairs of orange socks in a pack, there are 3 pairs of blue socks. If there were 6 pairs of orange socks, how many blue pairs would there be?

atoms.b: There would be <mat><gap>9</gap></mat> pairs of blue socks.

atoms.a: For every 8 strawberry-flavoured sweets in a packet, there are 12 apple-flavoured sweets. If there were 32 strawberry-flavoured sweets, how many apple-flavoured sweets would there be?
For every 5 robins in a bird sanctuary, there are 6 woodpeckers. If there were 42 woodpeckers, how many robins would there be?
In a pack of stickers, for every 10 blue stickers there are 12 pink stickers. If there were 100 blue stickers, how many pink stickers would there be?
For every 6 yellow lights, there are 4 white lights on a Christmas tree. If there were 32 white lights, how many yellow lights would there be?
For every 8 apples in the fruit bowl, there are 5 oranges. If there were 64 apples in the fruit bowl, how many oranges would there be?
